steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The five main aims of sentencing are: retribution (punishing the offender for what they have done), deterrence (discouraging the offender or others from reoffending), rehabilitation (reforming the offender to prevent future crime), incapacitation (protecting the public by removing dangerous offenders) and reparation (making the offender compensate the victim or society) | Key Fact: Deterrence is divided into individual deterrence (discouraging the specific offender) and general deterrence (discouraging others from committing similar offences) | Key Fact: The Sentencing Council issues guidelines that courts must follow unless it would be contrary to the interests of justice to do so, ensuring consistency in sentencing | Key Fact: Custodial sentences include: detention for offender
